issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: General 30,890.68, Cemetery 236.79, Cemetery Endowment 600.00, TIF Fund 42,157.05
issues.issue: The TIF Fund's 42,157.05 (57% of the line) is very likely tax increment (property tax), but it is printed as Local Receipts: Other, not a tax line. Under the tax-split rule the fund name doesn't make non-tax lines a tax, so 'other' is defensible. A person may want to decide.
